info.name: Leave Management - full API test
info.description: Run on a FRESH database, top to bottom (Collection Runner). Before running, set adminPassword to ADMIN_PASSWORD from D:\Java-learn\.env. Every request logs in as the right person, saves the ids it creates, and checks the status code. Step numbers match docs/API_TESTING_GUIDE.md.

item.name: 0. Public & login checks
item.description: No login needed for health; the other two must fail with 401.

exec: pm.test(".name = Ravi Kumar Singh", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().name).to.eql("Ravi Kumar Singh"));
pm.test(".reason = Requested 14 days but only 13 remaining", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().reason).to.eql("Requested 14 days but only 13 remaining"));

item.name: 3.3 Apply CASUAL 28 Sep - 2 Oct (4 working days)

exec: pm.test(".policyRemarks = Requested 20 days but only 9 remaining", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().policyRemarks).to.eql("Requested 20 days but only 9 remaining"));

item.name: 4. Teammate Sita - privacy checks
item.description: Login: Sita. She must not see or cancel the leave of Ravi.

item.name: 5. Manager Priya - approve
item.description: Login: Priya (step 5.8 logs in as Arjun).

exec: // tasks are created in order CASUAL, SICK, EARNED, so the cancelled SICK task id is between them

item.name: 6. Employee Ravi - after the decisions
item.description: Login: Ravi (step 6.9 uses the new password).

item.name: 7. HR - oversight & final checks
item.description: Login: HR admin (7.4 logs in as Sita, 7.7 needs no login).

item.name: 7.2 HR views leave of any employee
